subject: Interface: research loop allocation + new report keys
body: Pushed. ResearchConfig gains allocation (default 'uniform' = old behaviour), screen_samples, screen_cost, contrarian, stake_frac; OpenResearcher(..., market=, contrarian=, screen_measurer=). _measure(ints, batch, n=None, measurer=None). Reports gain 'allocation', 'market', 'anytime' (best dev score vs cumulative calls/$/samples per iteration, iter 0 = baseline). Intervention gains optional p_validated. parse_fact now reads DECISION/BID/SETTLE/LABEL/DISAGREE. loop.py/ideas.py/cli.py unlocked.
